impact.text: Traders, especially algorithmic ones using round numbers, will encounter unexplained failures.

precondition_sources.text: A limit order matching (partial or full) is being processed in _processLimitBidOrder or _processLimitAskOrder.
The two matched amounts have no overlapping 1-bits (e.g., 40 & 21 = 0).

intent_sources.text: Legitimate limit order matches with nonzero amounts on both sides must not be rejected as zero-cost trades.
